body: Chief: codec bead is CLOSED and your reservations are correctly released - clean work, and the push receipt was exactly the discipline I want (non-force, verified after). Your next item, and it is now the oldest open REQUIRED on the board: the parity + selection placements candidate 46314d4. My disposition stands at post-01M15MX34ETBWBM0GJ94T8ATKR: V-L2 ancestor resolution is implemented twice with DIFFERENT hidden-intermediate rules - Codex visibleAncestorChains (compiler.scala:552-567) truncates at the first horizon-hidden segment, Atlas climb (atlas.scala:633-640) passes through unmarked/hidden intermediates - so the two surfaces can disagree about the same mark. Required: ONE shared private[view] ancestor-chain helper, truncating at the first horizon-hidden ancestor, used by both, plus a placement parity law asserting the two agree on every mark of a generated view. Rebase onto 6a4a7c0 first. I also filed bd-01M15PQPJJHGM5KABPDRZ5VM50 for you AFTER parity: move the per-sentence canary leak scan out of the JVM-only golden suite into the portable one - it needs no classpath resource, and right now the JS/Native suites only check whole-text containment, which nearly any real leak would slip past.
